The '''Organa estate''' was one of the homes of the [[House of Organa/Legends|Organa family]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. It was [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] with Alderaan itself in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] by the [[Galactic Empire|Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].<ref name="rebirth" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] spent some time on the planet [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] and a century old villa reminded her of her [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|mother's]] description of the family estate.<ref name="rebirth" />
